description: The mechanism of one crowd-steered matching round on MatchPool, stated in one place. NOTHING IS POSTED AND NOTHING IS ANCHORED: the pool IS its own donation rail, so it accumulates the quadratic-funding sums AS EACH DONATION LANDS and the match is arithmetic over numbers the chain already holds — no root, no bond, no challenge window, no referee, no formulaHash. This file is therefore the normative PROSE statement of what the contract computes, and the machine-readable `parameters` the off-chain mirror (sdk/src/match) derives its constants from. The mirror exists for display and verification — and for predicting what a planned donation would do — never for asserting an answer to the chain. Integer arithmetic throughout; no floating point anywhere. One contract instance IS one round: anyone deploys one, anyone funds it, and it dissolves into claims.

parameterUnits.capNumerator/capDenominator: MatchPool.CAP_NUMERATOR / CAP_DENOMINATOR — the per-recipient ceiling on the match, as a fraction of the budget. Contract constants, identical for every round.

round.binding: Every other round constant is an immutable of the MatchPool instance and is read from it: matchToken, donationToken, donationStart, donationEnd, donationFloor. Nothing round-specific lives anywhere else, and a round with a different token, window or floor is a different instance — there is no registry of rounds and no shared configuration.
round.singleToken: A round counts donations in ONE token. Single-token rounds keep the arithmetic deterministic — no oracle, no FX. A round in another currency is another round. The match pays out in matchToken, which is deliberately a different currency from what donors give.
round.budget: MatchPool.finalize() (permissionless, once the donation window has ended) snapshots matchToken.balanceOf(pool) as the budget and freezes it. Overfunding beyond the finalized budget stays put, by the same no-escape-hatch doctrine as everywhere else — fund exactly.

donating.call: MatchPool.donate(recipient, amount). The tokens go STRAIGHT THROUGH to the recipient — the contract never holds a donation on anyone's behalf — while the round records the weight the donation earns.
donating.window: block.timestamp must be >= donationStart and < donationEnd. Start inclusive, end EXCLUSIVE. A donation outside the window is refused (DonationsNotOpen) rather than silently uncounted.
donating.floor: amount must be >= donationFloor (BelowFloor). The floor is what makes each counted donor real capital rather than a free vote.
donating.selfDonation: recipient == msg.sender is refused outright (SelfDonation), and recipient == address(0) is refused (ZeroAddress).
donating.strictAmount: The recipient's balance delta must equal `amount` exactly (AmountMismatch) — a fee-on-transfer donation token reverts rather than silently under-crediting.
donating.recipients: EMERGENT from donations. There is no recipient registry and no eligibility list: any address a donation reaches is a recipient.

score.form: Surplus-form quadratic funding: a recipient's weight is the coordination surplus (sum of square roots, squared) minus (sum of donations), so many small independent donors outweigh one large cheque.
score.integerForm: For each (donor, recipient) pair the contract keeps that donor's running total (MatchPool.donatedBy). On donation d: donatedBy[r][donor] goes from `was` to `was + amount_d`, and sumSqrt_r is corrected by -sqrt(was) +sqrt(was + amount_d), where sqrt is the floor integer square root (Babylonian, MatchPool.sqrt). sumOf_r += amount_d. weight_r = max(0, sumSqrt_r^2 - sumOf_r). The roots are taken PER DONOR, NOT per donation call — this is what makes the surplus form a sybil floor: splitting one cheque across n transactions is exactly neutral, so a recipient with a single donor scores zero however many times that donor pays. There is no per-donor cap and no fixed-point scale — the sqrt is taken on raw token units.
score.sybilFloor: A recipient funded by a single donation scores sqrt(a)^2 - a, which is zero up to integer truncation — so the cheapest sybil shape, a donor funding their own recipient, earns nothing. Self-donation is refused outright, and the floor prices every counted donation in real capital.
score.totalWeight: The summed weight across all recipients — the claim divisor. Maintained in O(1) as a delta on every donation, so a claim is a division rather than a sweep over donors.
score.homogeneity: weight is homogeneous of degree one in donation units, so the pro-rata split is independent of the donation token's decimals.

payout.gate: MatchPool.claim(recipient) requires finalized. Anyone may call on a recipient's behalf; the tokens always go to the recipient. Claims never expire and there is no sweep.
payout.match: matchOf(r) = floor(budget * weight_r / totalWeight), then clamped to floor(budget * 15 / 100).
payout.cap: THE EXCESS IS NOT REDISTRIBUTED — a capped recipient's overflow simply stays in the pool, and flooring dust likewise stays unclaimed: the budget is a ceiling, not a target. The cap binds identically for every recipient.
payout.onceOnly: One claim per recipient; the running `paid` total is checked against `budget` (BudgetExceeded).

reads.description: Everything the mirror needs is public chain state, emitted by the round itself. Log order is (blockNumber, logIndex) ascending; the window filter's input is the containing block's timestamp, which is consensus data.
consumed: MatchPool.Donation(address indexed donor, address indexed recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 weightAfter)

sybilPosture.statement: Resistance is BOUNDED, encoded entirely in the mechanism above (surplus form + donation floor + recipient cap) — not identity-based and not MACI-grade, accepted as the round's posture. A ring of k floor-funded donor wallets can still manufacture surplus for a fake recipient; the floor prices each ring wallet in real parked capital, the recipient cap bounds any single wallet's extraction to 15% of the budget, and a round runs when the match token has no market price — the farming incentive's lifetime minimum.
